caption: The drawing features a central rectangular panel with an ornate border, inside which there is handwritten text in German. The text area is framed by a red border with curved corners. Around this border, on a beige background, there are colorful stylized floral motifs, primarily tulip-like flowers. These flowers have petals in red, yellow, and green, and are placed symmetrically in the corners and along the edges of the composition. Scattered between the flowers are small red and yellow circles and green dots or ticks, creating a patterned effect. The entire drawing is centered on a larger piece of beige or off-white paper, which serves as a plain background for the main design. The composition is balanced, with the floral and decorative elements radiating from the central text panel.
title: Fraktur
